This Crazy Gif Shows How Fast a Rocket Has to Launch From Each Planet in the Solar System

I've seen this gif a couple of times today and mostly ignored it. However, I'd like to point out that this is actually the speed an object that does not generate thrust needs to escape a planet's gravity (i.e. it won't fall back when times goes to infinity, ignoring other bodies' influences and the such).

If you have an actual rocket, capable of generating thrust, you can leave the planet at whatever speed you want, all you need is that the thrust is greater than or equal the force of gravity.

tl;dr take this gif with a grain of salt, google "escape velocity".
